title: SEEDS-DR Schema
description: Schema for SEEDS Sustainability Decision Records in Biomedical Software Engineering

seeds_dr_id.description: Unique identifier of the decision record (e.g., SEEDS-DR-001)

decision_context.description: Context such as existing system assessment, digital health solution intake, or institutional software demand

system_or_solution.description: Name or description of the digital health system or solution

stakeholder_role.description: Role observing or reporting the concern (e.g., Patient, Healthcare Professional, Developer)

sustainability_concern.description: Description of the problem, risk, or quality need related to sustainability

related_criteria.description: Checklist items or subthemes supporting the interpretation

expected_effect.description: Expected first, second, or third-order sustainability effect

derived_nfr_or_decision.description: Non-functional requirement or architectural decision derived from the concern

acceptance_criterion.description: Condition indicating whether the requirement has been addressed

verification_evidence.description: Source or method used for testing, audits, or inspection

trade_offs.description: Conflicts, dependencies, or tensions among dimensions

decision_status.description: Current status of the decision record

human_review_notes.description: Reviewer notes, assumptions, or required expert judgment
